title: Town Picture Walk
hook: Know what happens there before stepping through a door.
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
responseSpace: one to two predictable beats of retrieval space before target confirmation
visualStyle: bright 3D neighborhood storybook, friendly streets and buildings, clean isolated subjects; visual identity: Town Picture Walk

creativeFingerprint.pointOfView: a child reading town functions and access
creativeFingerprint.authorialIntent: Make Town Picture Walk a place-function walk: home, education, health, emergency, retail, transport and public-information places are distinguished, while queue/sign/vehicle are labeled as non-place clues.
creativeFingerprint.lyricIdentity: A child walks one town route asking what happens here and whether the place is public, private, service, or transit.
